findings.title: Keep full candidate counts when workflow validation fails
findings.why_it_matters: A user can have an unmapped output field or missing-header workflow issue, then correct a source cell in the visible source table. The incremental evaluation receives only that row; because workflow issues skip the merge, its summary reports one candidate instead of the full dataset. Both the source-loaded status and full dataset counts become false, violating U11's count invariant until a full workflow rerun.
evidence: src/session/correction-overlay.ts:23 limits rows to source.rows.filter(r => r.id === changed); evaluate initializes candidates from that subset's rows.length and returns early on workflowIssues (src/engine/recipes.ts:62,79).
src/ui/Workspace.tsx:411 disables corrections only for busy, dirty, and recoverable state, so a completed validation with workflowIssues still permits this correction path.
findings.suggested_fix: If incremental evaluation has workflowIssues, retain the original dataset's candidate/input/skipped counts (or perform a full correctedRun evaluation for that branch) instead of returning the one-row summary. Add a regression with multiple source rows and an unmapped field, correcting then reverting one cell and comparing summaries against full evaluation.
